title: Austin meeting where Puthoff said Skinwalker Ranch needed a SCIF

tellings.quote: And then Hal finally looked around and said, "Well, we need a skiff for this one."

Peter Levendo is a past guest on the show and he described a meeting with Chris Mellon and Hal Puthoff where Skinwalker Ranch comes up and he has to leave the meeting because he doesn't have the proper clearances.
tellings.difference: Told secondhand by Jesse Michels, who adds that Levenda had to leave the meeting for lack of clearances.
tellings.link_reason: The same meeting with Mellon and Puthoff where Skinwalker Ranch came up and the subject needed clearance, which Levenda describes in the existing story.

as_told.title: Silence over Skinwalker Ranch appearance and equipment
as_told.place_text: meeting with Chris Mellon and Hal Puthoff

plain: At a meeting in Austin, Texas, a guest named Peter Levenda says a question came up about Skinwalker Ranch, a ranch in Utah, and about "an appearance" there and the equipment on site, and everyone in the room went silent. Levenda, who says he was in the room, tells Michels that a man named Hal Puthoff finally looked around and said, "Well, we need a skiff for this one," meaning a SCIF, a sealed and secured room where classified matters can be discussed; a man named Chris Mellon was there too. Michels, retelling it later, adds that Levenda had to leave the meeting because he did not have the right clearances, which, if so, would suggest the ranch was a classified matter.
